searchText: hey man, what's up? i wanted to give you this assignment for wednesday. nascar driver joey logano (penske driver) will talk exclusively to us at 1:30 pm wednesday. want you to talk to him as a way to preview the two races coming to mis next week. the basics on how weird this is year has been, how hes adjusting. i know you're off today and tomorrow, but nascar wants me to let them know today if we can do this. this sound good? stevie blanchard
